Billionaire Leon Black to Appear Before House Panel on Epstein Ties

Billionaire financier Leon Black is scheduled to appear before the House Committee on Oversight and Reform. This appearance is part of the committee's investigation into Jeffrey Epstein, following intensified scrutiny of Black's association with Epstein. The scrutiny increased after the Department of Justice released millions of files last year and this year. Black is expected to address payments totaling $158 million made to Epstein.
